title: Stability results for regularized least-squares problems via generalized Hessian expressions and monotone generalized equations
summary: We study perturbation and stability properties of solution mappings associated with convex regularized least-squares problems. We first establish an implicit function theorem for generalized equations governed by maximally monotone operators and smooth perturbations, yielding conditions for local Lipschitz continuity, directional differentiability, and semismoothness of solution mappings.
